verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable rules engine, webhooks, or event-triggered workflows for Oneleet. The automation it does show is either built-in (a CI check blocking new code-security issues, MDM policy enforcement) or schedule-based (Fieldwork evidence collection 'on your schedule'). Service keys allow external scripts and agents to call the workspace, but nothing shows Oneleet emitting events or letting users define trigger-action rules.
